notes.title: Big Update! Touch Support, Global Leaderboards, Mixed Reality and much more!
notes.content:
Happy new year everybody!
We've just released the latest version of Alpine Ski VR with many new exciting features!

NEW FEATURES
Global Leaderboards - Each level now has its own leaderboard. Complete a race and see where you place! Top scorers will be visible on the main menu. As this has only just been introduced, get playing now and be the first to get a top place!

Oculus Touch Support - You can now use Oculus Touch as ski poles to push yourself along and give you extra speed. They can also be used for navigating the menu.

Slalom Runs - After community feedback missing a gate now gives you a time penalty as opposed to ending the race.

Mixed Reality - Create mixed reality videos by dropping an externalcamera.cfg into the install path and switching on a third controller. We can't wait to see what you create!


TOP TIPS:
1. Only tilting your head will turn you. Turning your head will let you enjoy the view.
2. Keep your feet stationary, moving them will mean you're looking in the wrong direction. To check your direction of travel look down at your ski's and make sure you're feet are pointing in the same direction.

Feedback:
We'd love feedback from the community about how these updates are working for you or any other suggestion to make our game awesome!
